results.statement: Zero- and nonzero-syndrome cycles cannot be the same exact transition isomorph when the compared anatomy preserves ordered delta composition, because syndrome is invariant under that comparison.
Equality of the eight coarse local/topological cycle summaries is not sufficient for TI: an exact matched signature contains both a zero and nonzero cycle.
Nonlocal transport-only recursive equivalence occurs in flat 4x5 as well as obstructed 5x4; it is not a sufficient transition-anatomy signature for frustration.

Tested cases support a useful decomposition into cycle opportunity (reachability/topology) and cocycle frustration (ordered sheet-delta composition). The former can vary under transpose without the latter becoming nonzero.

Within the line-family intervention, H+D transition/residual interaction is enough to create frustrated cycles in 5x4 k=4 but not 4x5; the unresolved differentiator therefore lies below line-family presence alone.

The audited transpose pairs are exact isomorphs under a static winning-line-hypergraph view, but they cannot be equivalent under a cocycle-preserving dynamic transition view because their flat/frustrated results differ. Gravity/support transition roles are therefore load-bearing for the stronger comparison.
The k=4 H+D obstruction channel is not stable across k: at k=3 H alone and V+D are inclusion-minimal obstructing channels on 5x4. Family labels alone are not a cross-k transition signature.

Pruning continuations that fail remaining-move or exact support-release/turn capacity does not restore dynamic integrability. Thus the static-to-dynamic transpose split is not explained solely by individually unrealizable residual requirements.

Two independent 5x4 k4 obstruction families share a transition-endpoint sheet distinction expressible without raw column or mask identity: exclusive residuals are one-hole subsets of the current open-cap set selecting opposite holes from one two-column pair.

The missing-cap self-incidence bit cannot be a global transition potential coordinate because two same-parity flat reconvergences in the repaired 5x4 carrier change that bit. It remains a local descriptor of the robust contradiction only.

ti_nonclaims: No universal cycle mechanism is claimed.
The k=4 rank+action-word classifier is not promoted to a TI invariant across k because holdout support is incomplete.
